offers.rationale: C2 is the lowest-cost candidate that can become safe with my concession (total_usd 1364.1, holding_fuel_kg 400), and its R-1 failure is resolved by resequencing AA2243 at SL-1342. C4 avoids my concession but carries 1000 kg holding_fuel_kg and 25 min extra holding.

C2 is the lowest-cost candidate at 1364.1 USD with 11 min overtime, and its 10 min extra holding burns 400 kg, leaving 2160 kg that meets the 1800 kg reserve under F-1. It is within my fuel-safe holding limit of 19 min, and it is only safe if ATC_EARLIER_SLOT and my concession are confirmed, since R-1 currently fails.

C2 has the lowest total_usd (1364.1) of the candidates that can become safe, and it passes G-2 (gate B7 free with buffer) and C-1 (CRW-B7 on shift) with 11 min overtime. C1 now fails G-2 after the concessions, and C3 and C4 fail F-1 and cost more (3415.5 and 3408.0).

votes.rationale: C2 passes my checks R-1 (slot SL-1342 released, AA2243 resequenced to SL-1409 within capacity 20), W-1 (180 s behind B6294 meets the 120 s large-large requirement), and T-1 (route avoids closed taxiway D). Its total_usd of 1364.1 is the lowest of the viable candidates.

Frozen proposal C2 passes F-1 with 2160 kg at landing against the 1800 kg reserve, within my 19 min fuel-safe holding limit. Its total cost of 1364.1 USD is the lowest of the candidates that can become safe, so I accept.

The frozen proposal C2 passes my checks G-1, G-2 (gate B7 free with 10 min buffer), G-3 and C-1 (CRW-B7 on shift). Its total_usd of 1364.1 with 11 min overtime is the lowest cost among the candidates that can be made safe.
